goal: First complex factory benchmark: genuine local flock,50/200 bodies and social-rule ablations. Not5,000-drone mission evidence.
fixed: All16 runs declared before inspecting mission outcomes.120s horizon; ideal observations; airflow off;100Hz control; same shared broad route and local safety filter for all social ablations. No scheduler or per-drone trajectories.
initialization: Jittered3D lattice with random initial velocities, shuffled IDs and no lane assignments.0.75m spacing,±0.08m jitter. Cross-section grows to16×9 lattice sites; additional count extends the initial cloud longitudinally. This changes initial volume, not fixed-volume density.
geometry: All34 solid boxes are checked including side walls/ceiling even when hidden in the viewer. Sphere body envelope radius0.075m. Exact straight-segment/box distance and conservative swept-pair candidate search; actual rigid-body paths between steps are approximated by segments.
acceptance: Report every completion/contact/connectivity outcome. Four planned5→2.5ms comparisons: same count/stop, end difference<0.01s and maximum final position difference<0.01m. No source tuning after protocol. A failed comparison is retained.
timing: Three concurrent numerical workers; descriptive Node wall times only. Not isolated scaling performance or live browser physics.
